title: Advanced Population Dynamics and Assessment
description:
Prerequisite: MEES607 or BIOM601; or permission of instructor.
Credit only granted for: MEES698D or MEES712.
Formerly: MEES698D. Quantitative and modeling skills, including understanding of population dynamics and responses of populations to exploitation and management actions. Coverage of population models of production, mortality, stock and recruitment, age and growth, and harvesting, and methods for using these models to provide management advice.
